description: Defines the mac_controller class and related structures for MAC layer control in a 5G/4G radio system, including UE management, cell configuration, and scheduling interfaces.

classes.name: mac_ue_context
classes.description: Represents a UE context with identifiers and cell association.

classes.name: mac_controller
classes.description: Main class managing MAC layer operations, including UE and cell management, scheduling, and configuration.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell configuration to the MAC layer and forwards it to the scheduler.

methods.name: remove_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell configuration from the MAC layer and scheduler.

methods.name: get_cell_controller
methods.description: Retrieves the controller for a specific cell.

methods.name: get_subframe_time_mapper
methods.description: Returns the subframe time mapping object.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request
methods.description: Handles a request to create a new UE in MAC and scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Handles a request to delete a UE from MAC and scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration requests for a UE.

methods.name: handle_ul_ccch_msg
methods.description: Processes UL CCCH messages from UEs.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds a UE context by its index.

methods.name: find_by_rnti
methods.description: Finds a UE context by its RNTI.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE solely in MAC controller.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from MAC controller.
